To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the influence of leaf area index (LAi) on light interception, and hence on tomato yield, is not very strong in summer conditions; 2) the influence of LAi on yield is much stronger in winter conditions; 3) LAi is not the only factor that affects yield, but also fruit partitioning, and 4) LAi is a useful tool in the optimization of tomato production.
